title: Great sheets, fits perfect and is super soft!
text: Great sheets, fits perfect and is super soft!. This is a really nice deep pocketed sheet set. I got a queen size and it fits my bed perfectly. I have washed this set twice since I have received it and the gray color is still vibrant and the sheets are virtually wrinkle free. These sheets are super soft and luxurious and I have already purchased a set for my son and daughter in law because I was so impressed. Spoil yourself (at a reasonable price) and buy a premium set of sheets for an optimal night's sleep. Highly recommend!
